X.note: Symmetrical CGI lane at dusk. The peeling plaster texture is convincing, but the frame is very dark and the lane is almost black. A faint dark figure sits mid-lane at the end of the shadow, and it is barely readable as a person. The tiny Union flag is the only focal point and is too small to read on a phone. The roofs are plain slabs and the stucco is uniformly ruined, with no sign of a siege-era working town. The window glows are a flat orange.

Y.note: Almost identical to X but a little darker and flatter. The lane is empty or the figure is nearly invisible, so there is no human scale or story. The sky is a flat blue gradient. The same tiny flag, uniform decay and dead-black lower third apply, so it will crush to black on a small screen.

why: The two frames are nearly identical, but X is slightly brighter and has a faint figure in the lane that gives it some life and scale, while Y reads as an empty dark corridor.
top_fix_for_weaker: Lift the shadow exposure and add a lantern or fire glow on the cobbles. Put clearly lit, period-dressed soldiers or civilians (tricorn hats, coats, a handcart) in the lane, and enlarge the flag or add other readable period cues such as shutters, signs, barrels and rubble.
anachronisms_seen: Plain flat slab roofs and uniform modern-looking stucco with no tile or timber detail
Flat, uniform window glow that looks like emissive game lights rather than candle or lantern light
A thin horizontal cable or pipe line across the right facade
Rectangular recessed doorways of uniform modern proportions
